integrity: The universal statement is proved symbolically. The bundled finite computations are independent stress tests, not substitutes for the proof. Originality is supported by statement-level source comparison but cannot exclude unindexed older observations.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the Datta--Upadhyay family \(Q_{2m+1,2}\) and to retractions onto its two parity-induced subcomplexes; no classification of all self-maps or all Möbius-band subcomplexes is claimed.
title: Three simplicial retractions onto each parity Möbius band in \(Q_{2m+1,2}\)
